input.prompt: An original42.81-second minimal modern electronic / light tech-house instrumental at123 BPM. Playful and warm yet polished. Solid controlled four-on-the-floor kick, dry tight clap/snare, gentle shaker and hi-hat, a simple bouncy syncopated rounded synth bass. Short muted synth plucks, soft filtered electric keyboard chords, and sparse rounded vowel-like filter pulses made only with synthesizers (no human voices). Keep space between notes, low-mid weight and crisp transients, not aggressive EDM. Establish groove quickly, maintain a confident steady pulse with occasional brief layer dropouts, then a clean gentle fade from41 seconds to the end. No speech, no singing, no vocal recordings, no phone sounds, no effects. Entirely new composition.
